rows.speaker: Chiram Sldr
rows.en: Prime pickings, this! All units, don't hit the containers!
rows.display_text:
「Prime pickings, this! All units, don't hit
the containers!」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: N-no good! At this ship's speed, we can't outrun them!
rows.display_text:
「N-no good! At this ship's speed, we
can't outrun them!」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: Radar contact! It's an Emaan ship!
rows.display_text: 「Radar contact! It's an Emaan ship!」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: Has help arrived!?
rows.display_text: 「Has help arrived!?」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: T-that's the Factory's Glomar!
rows.display_text: 「T-that's the Factory's Glomar!」

rows.speaker: Chiram Sldr
rows.en: Oh... a Singularity's ship. But that's nothing to do with us deserters.
rows.display_text:
「Oh... a Singularity's ship. But that's
nothing to do with us deserters.」

rows.speaker: Chiram Sldr
rows.en: If you're going to get in our way, we'll knock you right out of the sky...!
rows.display_text:
「If you're going to get in our way, we'll
knock you right out of the sky...!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: I like it. When you say villain lines like that, it makes things a lot easier for us.
rows.display_text:
「I like it. When you say villain lines like
that, it makes things a lot easier for us.」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: This is Shaya Thoov of the Factory.
rows.display_text: 「This is Shaya Thoov of the Factory.」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: We'll take it from here. Please, the caravan, fall back.
rows.display_text:
「We'll take it from here. Please, the
caravan, fall back.」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: W-who'd accept help from the likes of you!
rows.display_text:
「W-who'd accept help from the likes of
you!」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: Huh...?

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: We know! We know you're wanted fugitives from the Emaan homeland!
rows.display_text:
「We know! We know you're wanted
fugitives from the Emaan homeland!」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: We can't possibly accept help from people like that!
rows.display_text:
「We can't possibly accept help from
people like that!」

rows.speaker: Maai
rows.en: That's so mean! And here we came all this way to help!
rows.display_text:
「That's so mean! And here we came all
this way to help!」

rows.speaker: Lieea
rows.en: If you're going to talk like that, we're just going home!
rows.display_text:
「If you're going to talk like that, we're
just going home!」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: We can't do that.
rows.display_text: 「We can't do that.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Shaya's right. We're not here because anyone asked us to be. Call it volunteer work, if you like.
rows.display_text:
「Shaya's right. We're not here because
anyone asked us to be. Call it volunteer
work, if you like.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Even if you push us away, we're just going to do this our own way.
rows.display_text:
「Even if you push us away, we're just
going to do this our own way.」

rows.speaker: Mimsy
rows.en: Kei...

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: So there you have it, folks of the caravan. We're taking care of these bandits on our own say-so.
rows.display_text:
「So there you have it, folks of the
caravan. We're taking care of these
bandits on our own say-so.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: That's fine with everyone, right?
rows.display_text: 「That's fine with everyone, right?」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: Understood. I'm with you on this, Kei.
rows.display_text: 「Understood. I'm with you on this, Kei.」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: All units, protect the Emaan ship while we intercept the bandits!
rows.display_text:
「All units, protect the Emaan ship while
we intercept the bandits!」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: W-what do we do?
rows.display_text: 「W-what do we do?」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: Everyone protects themselves! Don't count on them for anything!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone protects themselves! Don't
count on them for anything!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Man... you're not the honest type, are you. If you were girls, I bet you'd give me a real hard time.
rows.display_text:
「Man... you're not the honest type, are
you. If you were girls, I bet you'd give
me a real hard time.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Well... that's about the size of it.
rows.display_text: 「Well... that's about the size of it.」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: W-well...
rows.display_text: 「W-well...」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Whoa, no need for thanks. We just did it because we wanted to.
rows.display_text:
「Whoa, no need for thanks. We just did
it because we wanted to.」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: That won't do! We're people of Emaan, the nation of commerce!
rows.display_text:
「That won't do! We're people of Emaan,
the nation of commerce!」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: Service demands payment! At the very least, accept our words of thanks!
rows.display_text:
「Service demands payment! At the very
least, accept our words of thanks!」

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: Thank you! We're grateful for your rescue!
rows.display_text:
「Thank you! We're grateful for your
rescue!」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: Yes... we've received your thanks, loud and clear.
rows.display_text:
「Yes... we've received your thanks, loud
and clear.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Huh... here I thought you were just stubborn, but you've got an honest side too.
rows.display_text:
「Huh... here I thought you were just
stubborn, but you've got an honest side
too.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: (If only Athena would open up to me like this too...)
rows.display_text:
（(If only Athena would open up to me
like this too...)）

rows.speaker: Emaan Soldier
rows.en: W-waaaaaahh!
rows.display_text: 「W-waaaaaahh!」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: N-no way...!
rows.display_text: 「N-no way...!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Damn it! There's no point in us even being here at this rate!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it! There's no point in us even
being here at this rate!」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: An Emaan caravan is under attack by the Chiram, you say?
rows.display_text:
「An Emaan caravan is under attack by
the Chiram, you say?」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: Though calling them Chiram, it looks like they're just a bunch of deserters who broke off from the regular army.
rows.display_text:
「Though calling them Chiram, it looks like
they're just a bunch of deserters who
broke off from the regular army.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: So basically a band of bandits, huh. Can't very well look the other way on that.
rows.display_text:
「So basically a band of bandits, huh.
Can't very well look the other way on
that.」

rows.speaker: Mome
rows.en: Lord Kei, are you going to go help Emaan!?
rows.display_text:
「Lord Kei, are you going to go help
Emaan!?」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: That's the plan, yeah?
rows.display_text: 「That's the plan, yeah?」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: ...But Emaan tried to capture Kei and control his mind.
rows.display_text:
「...But Emaan tried to capture Kei and
control his mind.」

rows.speaker: Mimsy
rows.en: Since we're Emaan people ourselves, part of us wants to go help the caravan under attack, but...
rows.display_text:
「Since we're Emaan people ourselves, part
of us wants to go help the caravan under
attack, but...」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Hold it right there, Mimsy. Let's just get ready to launch.
rows.display_text:
「Hold it right there, Mimsy. Let's just
get ready to launch.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Sure, I'm plenty mad about the way Emaan did things. But that's a separate matter from this.
rows.display_text:
「Sure, I'm plenty mad about the way
Emaan did things. But that's a separate
matter from this.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Ignoring people in trouble would sit pretty badly with me anyway.
rows.display_text:
「Ignoring people in trouble would sit
pretty badly with me anyway.」

rows.speaker: Mome
rows.en: Understood, Lord Kei!
rows.display_text: 「Understood, Lord Kei!」

rows.speaker: Mimsy
rows.en: Thank you, Kei.
rows.display_text: 「Thank you, Kei.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Your thanks alone is more than enough reward for me.
rows.display_text:
「Your thanks alone is more than enough
reward for me.」

rows.speaker: Athena
rows.en: (Lending a hand to those who hunt him... What is that man thinking?)
rows.display_text:
（(Lending a hand to those who hunt
him... What is that man thinking?)）

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: Can't quite figure Kei out, Athena?
rows.display_text: 「Can't quite figure Kei out, Athena?」

rows.speaker: Athena
rows.en: Y-yeah...
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah...」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: But it's exactly because he's that kind of person that I and everyone on the Glomar wanted to bet on him.
rows.display_text:
「But it's exactly because he's that kind
of person that I and everyone on the
Glomar wanted to bet on him.」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: Even this world's future, for that matter.
rows.display_text:
「Even this world's future, for that
matter.」
